info.description: The Pet Adoption Details API provides access to comprehensive information about pets available for adoption. Through this API, users can retrieve specific details about pets, including their characteristics, care needs, and adoption status. It serves as a valuable resource for potential pet owners, animal shelters, and agencies involved in pet adoption initiatives. Typical consumers of this API include pet adoption websites, mobile applications, and organizations seeking to promote animal welfare.

get.summary: Retrieve detailed information about a specific pet.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch comprehensive details about a particular pet, including its characteristics, health status, and owner information. Use the pet's unique identifier to get the relevant details.
